page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmhfr6.20xlarge is a memory-optimized cloud instance powered by x86_64 architecture and KVM virtualization. The system features a dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a base clock frequency of 3.1 GHz across 80 virtual CPUs. CPU allocation is fully dedicated, ensuring consistent execution without thread contention.

The hardware configuration provides 768.0 GB of system memory, resulting in a high density of 9.6 GB of RAM per vCPU. Local storage is not bundled with this server type, requiring attached block storage for boot volumes and data persistence. Network networking capabilities feature a 32 Gbps baseline bandwidth. The server includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From an architectural perspective, the 9.6:1 RAM-to-vCPU ratio offers strong resource efficiency for memory-dominated workloads that do not require proportional scaling of compute cores. The absence of built-in local NVMe storage reduces local maintenance overhead but necessitates network storage dependency. This instance profile fits memory-intensive enterprise tasks, including large-scale in-memory databases, big data analytics engines, heavy caching nodes, and enterprise resource planning systems.
